outline: The Si-based devices are popularly applied in integrated circuits in this era. Through this learning, the students can review the fundamental solid-state electronic devices and deeply dig into the modern semiconductor devices such as FinFETs with 5-nm and 3-nm gate lengths. After this study, the students are expected to equip the capability in characteristic analysis of nano-Si devices. In this course, the teaching topics include Electrons and Holes in Semiconductors, Motion and Recombination of Electrons and Holes,PN and Metal-Semiconductor Junctions, MOS Capacitor and MOS Field-effect Transistors, etc.
